def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the solid separator row or column.
    sep_row = next(
        (r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1
         and all(grid[r][0] == grid[r][c] for c in range(w))),
        None
    )
    sep_col = next(
        (c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))),
        None
    )

    if sep_col is not None:
        left = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        right = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        common = set(map(tuple, left))  # unused; determine shared colors below
        shared = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
        bg = min(shared) if shared else 0
        return [[3 if left[r][c] == bg and right[r][c] == bg else bg
                 for c in range(len(left[0]))] for r in range(h)]

    top, bottom = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
    shared = set(x for row in top for x in row) & set(x for row in bottom for x in row)
    bg = min(shared) if shared else 0
    return [[3 if top[r][c] == bg and bottom[r][c] == bg else bg
             for c in range(len(top[0]))] for r in range(len(top))]
